summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of Career OS MVP. Created pytest suite (28 tests, 100% pass) covering auth, node lifecycle, cross-user isolation, admin boundary, JD analysis, evidence matching, generation and validation gates. Frontend E2E ran the complete golden path as admin (login -> 5 VERIFIED James nodes -> Allstate DPM opportunity -> 15 tiered requirements -> evidence matching (COVERED 9 / GAPS 6) -> generation with per-claim CKN trace badges -> validation 10/10 gates PASS) plus a non-admin user run (admin nav hidden, /admin redirects, preflight BLOCKED, buttons disabled, UI register/logout). yarn build succeeds with zero warnings/errors. Isolation and admin-boundary invariants independently confirmed.

minor.issue: No rate limiting / brute-force lockout: 6+ consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 with no throttle (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails). Valid creds still work, so not blocking, but auth is unthrottled.

allow_credentials=True combined with a possible '*' origin default (os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','*')) is an invalid/unsafe combo for credentialed requests; require explicit origins from env with no wildcard fallback.
No ObjectId validation and no 404 when user_id does not exist -> a malformed id raises bson InvalidId (500) and a valid-but-unknown id returns 200 with a no-op.

Returns gap:true rows for every requirement when matching has never been run, i.e. it is indistinguishable from a real 'no sufficient evidence' result. Recommend a matched/has_run flag in the response (drives the frontend bug below).

ui_bugs.issue: Evidence Map renders the pre-match map (TOTAL 15 / COVERED 0 / GAPS 15, 'No sufficient canonical evidence' on every requirement) both before matching is run and while matching is in flight — a false, alarming 'everything is a gap' state. No loading/skeleton state while busy==='match'. Only after matching completes does it flip to COVERED 9 / GAPS 6.

Invite Pilot modal cannot be dismissed with Escape and its fixed full-screen overlay intercepts pointer events on the sidebar nav, so nav clicks silently fail until the X is clicked. Add Escape handler + backdrop click-to-close.

data-testid="validation-gate-status" is present only once (summary card); the 10 individual gate cards use data-testid="policy-rule-item" with no per-gate testid/status attribute, so a test cannot assert individual gate results.

integration_issues.issue: Representation and Validation are fetched unconditionally on mount and log 404s to the browser console before generation/validation exist. Functionally harmless but noisy; treat 404 as an empty state without a console error.

issues: Success toast (top-right) overlaps the 'Back' link on the opportunity detail header, making it briefly unclickable.
Rationale text uses text-slate-500 on #0B0F17 (contrast ratio ~3:1) — below WCAG AA for body text; same for 'TOTAL 15' meta labels.

action_items: Evidence Map: distinguish 'matching not yet run' from real gaps (backend flag or frontend guard) and show a loading state while matching is in flight — current UI shows 15 false gaps.
Admin invite modal: add Escape/backdrop close so the overlay does not block sidebar navigation.
Consider login throttling/lockout and remove the '*' CORS fallback while allow_credentials=True.
Add per-gate data-testid (e.g. validation-gate-{name}) for validation cards.
critical_code_review_comments: OwnedRepo is a clean single choke point and it holds: every cross-user probe (GET/PATCH/POST verify/reject/match/generate/validate on another user's node/opportunity) returned 404, admin included. No client-supplied owner_user_id is ever trusted.
ser()/ser_keep() correctly strip _id and owner_user_id from all responses; no ObjectId leakage observed.
Generation verified as non-mutating: career_knowledge node states/evidence/verified_at were byte-identical before and after POST /generate.
server.py is 602 lines and approaching the 700-line split threshold; auth/career/opportunity/admin routers should be modularized before further growth.
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in current FastAPI — migrate to the lifespan context manager.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all golden-path flows pass; evidence-map pre-match false-gap state and admin modal overlay are defects)

seed_data_creation: Registered TEST_usera_*/TEST_userb_*/TEST_reg_* users for isolation, TEST_invite_* pilots via admin invite, TEST_ui_* user via UI register, plus TEST_* career nodes and 'TEST *' opportunities under those throwaway users. Admin account got one extra 'Director of Product Management / Allstate' opportunity (golden regression). No seeded James Williams data modified.
test_credentials: willsky.james@gmail.com / CareerOS2026! (admin, owns seeded James KB); new users via POST /api/auth/register
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run with configured pytest.ini; full run ~100s because of live AI calls). It covers isolation (TestIsolation), admin boundary (TestAdminBoundary) and the golden path (TestGoldenPath: JD analysis -> match -> generate -> validate, asserting 10 gates pass, IP never rendered as employer, reverse-chronological order, per-bullet source_node_id, and no canonical write-back). Note GoldenPath tests are order-dependent within the class (match must run before generate/validate) — run the whole class, not single -k tests. Frontend flow verified end-to-end at /opportunities/{id}; when scripting, wait for generate/validate buttons to become enabled (they are disabled while busy or before map/rep exist) rather than waiting only on selectors.
rca_of_the_issue: Evidence-map false gaps: GET /api/opportunities/{id}/evidence-map builds one row per requirement and sets gap=len(matches)==0, so with zero evidence_matches documents (matching never run / still running) it legitimately returns all-gap rows. OpportunityDetail fetches this on mount and renders it because `map` is non-null, so the 'Run Evidence Matching to build the map' placeholder is never shown and the user sees 'No sufficient canonical evidence' for every requirement. Fix by adding a has_matching_run/matched flag server-side (or checking evidence_matches count) and gating the table on it plus busy==='match'.
